Entry Point 01

Case Review & Charging Decisions

Compliance Automation

Automated validation of charging decisions against the Full Code Test, evidential stage sufficiency, and public interest stage criteria under CPS Code for Crown Prosecutors.

Risk Detection & Early Warning

Detection of weak prosecution cases, disclosure failures, and evidential gaps via case file quality analysis against CPS digital case file standards.

Natural Language Policy Analysis

NLP analysis of case summaries, witness statements, and expert reports against CPS evidential sufficiency thresholds.

Predictive Analytics

Charging decision outcome prediction from evidence quality scoring, witness reliability assessment, and legal precedent analysis.

Evidence Synthesis

Police evidence, witness testimony, and expert reports into prosecution decision dossiers.

Document Intelligence

Extraction from case files, evidential reviews, and pre-charge advice records for case management.

Stakeholder Reporting

Charging decision dashboards showing case throughput, acceptance rates, and evidential sufficiency trends.

Real-time Monitoring

Case file submission tracking, charging decision timeline monitoring, and police-CPS interface management.
